chunks: There is no harm if they come before their fathers or their sons, or their brothers and their brothers' and sisters' sons, or their women folk or captive maids they possess. Follow the commands of God. Verily God is witness to everything.

key_terms.مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُنَّ: What their right hands possess (captive maids)

ai.seo_question: Who are the mahram relatives a woman does not need to wear full hijab in front of according to the Quran?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Al-Ahzab (33:59 contextually linked) specifies the mahram relatives before whom women may lower their gaze and relax strict hijab, including parents, children, siblings, and female servants. It concludes with an exhortation to God-consciousness, affirming God's omniscience.
